notes.title: Amazing Human for Beta 1.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]New item, new vehicle and new world added! ![/b][/h1]

[h1]New items[/h1]

[h1]Gravity control device[/h1]

After holding the gravity control device, you can press "F" to change gravity downward, weightlessness, upward.
This is falling somewhere in the world.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/ed84e99d2a168244f910813a8f02ed2708800ac9.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/af74ab955235f5190a2e42766bc7cb3a0c4f1e23.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/111ed8ed872cca86a4e148c48b08ab78d1fff178.png[/img]

[h1]Missile target marker[/h1]

You can put a target marker by right clicking after holding it.
It gets annihilated when it is involved in an explosion.
This is falling somewhere in the world.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/409de9f4a1a7324e091d330a1d6fc6e9297dbc12.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/f056e97cf9661c29a0371f43194558de32aa099b.png[/img]

[h1]Adhesive missile target marker[/h1]

You can put a target marker by right clicking after holding it.
I stick to the object I touch and do not leave.
It gets annihilated when it is involved in an explosion.
This is falling somewhere in the world.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/69eee781d6c549cd6af5f59aea9f1aec78d45efe.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/17ff574857d53575bf7de7a6ebad1e54b5b36815.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/4acc42fc136fe7186edc47f325d49ca7452c1894.png[/img]


[h1]Missile[/h1]

As missile target markers are placed, missiles are launched from missile launchers in three locations on the island.
This missile flies closest to it regardless of the order in which the missile target markers were placed.
The missile that lost the goal will continue to fly forever in the direction that it flew.
As long as the target marker exists, missiles will fly no matter how far it is.
If you fire two missiles with two target markers at the same time, each other's missiles will collide and explode the moment you get out of the missile launcher.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/b09256eb0d03ab04d60777bfb3b8c2d006dde9aa.png[/img]

[h1]New vehicle[/h1]

[h1]Orange car[/h1]

It is an orange car.
The maximum speed is tripled compared with the blue car.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/d1b65c57f8308259e1584659fc08a39c7b1ae46e.png[/img]

[h1]Black luxury car[/h1]

It is a black luxury car.
There is no difference from a blue car.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/99a105b636f938cfc4fe2517a0dae618fb9511b6.png[/img]

[h1]New world[/h1]

It is a flat world.
It is a very wide and flat world.
There are weapons, items, cars, circuit tracks that are implemented.
Here you can check the new item.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/72dd977fe485dbae85715118c71de1112aaf59ec.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/76e2ac78c10e0890f770bb1ad34eaa42f0b21be3.png[/img]

notes.title: Amazing Human for Beta 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Change point[/h1]

·Improvement of camera behavior.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/6f9067d4b714dec01cac0324397c2fd6578be350.png[/img]
· Construction of a skyscraper started.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/4bb7856213ccddcf74753b679cfb310a2a505e12.png[/img]
· When you are on the vehicle, press "C" to become FPS viewpoint
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/a55d87017d1ce01ef8b78b4c9063cd8cddb7ee23.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460872/2c41fdb230dcbb3f1c30dcc33a760066c6f0a671.png[/img]
·optimisation
· Add a simple load screen.

[h1]Problems being resolved[/h1]

· Extraordinarily long road.
· Being "Not Responding" during loading.
